ambiguity_notes: Possible doubt: the writing item was 'not attempted - pt declined'. A6 removes a total only for a partial ICE without a stated total; here the examiner states 6/10 and scores the item 0 (all items scored, A34), so the total is used. Declining is not a documented language, hearing, vision or writing barrier or baseline cognitive impairment (A10), so no 7.5. If the Day 4 total were discarded, the highest supported grade would be 1 and the documented 'not assessable' day would make the result 7.4; I do not apply that reading because the note states the total. The Day 7 'not assessable' statement (apheresis/IR) is recorded for the case-level unassessed-period flag.
